lines.speaker: header
lines.text: CALUMET COUNTY SHERIFF'S DEPARTMENT Page 48 Complaint No. File Number 05-0157-955

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: I'm really........by the garage, by the house, by the fire pit. I know you saw something. ... Mark and I both can go back to the district attorney and say, ah, ... Dassey ... came forward and finally told us. Can imagine how this was weighing on him? They'll understand that.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: We'll go to bat for ya, but you have to be honest with us.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: Can you get close? Can you get close ... to telling us the truth.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: It's OK, it's a big step .....a step toward feeling better about yourself, to recovery, to not crying at night because of this stuff happenin'....................what you saw. I promise you I'll not let you hang out there alone, but we've gotta have the truth. The truth is gonna be terrible..........your mom..........

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: We're not gonna run back and tell your grandma and grandpa what you told us or anything like that. OK.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: ..Talk to us Brendan if you want this resolved.

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: ...............some clothes like a blue shirt, some pants ...

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Where did he get the clothes from?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Where in the garage were they?
